jobs.detail: This part is the long rounded rectangular CHOKE exterior: four subtle cross-body division seams, a small outlet near the top of the left end face, two tiny low front fasteners, and a small stepped circular rear connector. Broad smooth flat sides; NO lengthwise side ribs and NO birdcage slots.
jobs.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Make one finished square game gunsmith attachment icon.
Input image 1 is the APPROVED FRAME EDIT TARGET: preserve its exact thick chamfered dark steel square frame, angular corner plates with four round rivets, silver inner circular ring, scratched recessed charcoal backing, bevel proportions, frontal lighting and very narrow transparent outer margin. Do not simplify or redesign that frame. Remove only the central existing muzzle brake.
Input image 2 is the ACTUAL INSTALLED MODEL SHAPE reference. Insert only that single attachment, preserving its exact silhouette, aspect ratio, holes, seams and mounting connector. Do not borrow the old muzzle brake geometry. Keep the muzzle axis perfectly horizontal, front outlet at LEFT and rear mounting neck at RIGHT; up remains up. Use its same slight front-left side view to reveal the left outlet.
Render the attachment in the same detailed realistic neutral silver-gray / dark-gray metal icon treatment as input 1: crisp geometric edge highlights, finely brushed metal, restrained fine wear and dark readable openings; avoid plain white/plastic smooth shading. No hue, rust, orange, blue tint, added markings, text, symbols, watermark, extra parts or duplicate object. Do not add arbitrary mechanical features.
Center the complete attachment within the inner ring, about 74% of the square canvas width; leave clearance at both ends, no overlap with ring/frame. Keep frame interior opaque and only the narrow exterior transparent. Output one high-quality square RGBA PNG matching the reference icon family.
